title: Authorization scope is not identity
problem: A caller is correctly identified and is still refused, and the agent must decide what to change.
failure: A 403 was read as a sign-in problem and the agent re-authenticated repeatedly with the same identity, which was never the obstacle.
correction: Check the granted scope against the operation. A correct identity with insufficient scope fails exactly like this.
transfer: Re-identifying a caller cannot grant it a permission it was never given.
limits: FIXTURE. Test data for tests/retrieval_bilingual_R02.py. A deliberate near-neighbour of fx-authn, present so that a retrieval change which conflates the two is detected rather than rewarded.
